title: `SSTORE2.read(pointer, start)` — Unchecked `start` Can Underflow `DATA_OFFSET` Addition
impact: `read(address pointer, uint256 start)` does `start += DATA_OFFSET` (i.e., `+1`). If a caller passes `type(uint256).max`, this overflows. Since the pragma is `>=0.8.0`, the checked arithmetic **reverts** — so no silent corruption, but the function reverts with a panic instead of a descriptive error, and the two-argument `read(pointer, start, end)` similarly computes `end - start` after both are incremented, which can revert on `end < start` post-increment in unexpected ways.
